categories.main_business_segments: Avary Holding (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing industry, focusing on R&D, design, manufacturing, sales, and services of various PCB products. Its product lines include communication boards, consumer electronics and computer boards, automotive/server boards, and other specialized boards. The company serves sectors such as smartphones, network equipment, tablets, wearables, laptops, servers, automotive electronics, and AI data centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB technologies including flexible printed circuits (FPC), surface mount assembly (SMA), substrate-like PCB (SLP), high-density interconnector (HDI), Mini LED, rigid PCB (RPCB), and rigid-flex boards. It utilizes cutting-edge manufacturing processes such as laser drilling for microvias, cavity technology, embedded components, and high-frequency/high-speed signal transmission techniques. The company also integrates digital transformation and AI-driven smart manufacturing to enhance production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Avary Holding serves leading global electronic brands and ODMs primarily in the communication electronics, consumer electronics, computing, automotive, and AI server markets. Key customers include international smartphone manufacturers and Tier 1 automotive suppliers. The company’s products are embedded in smartphones, routers, servers, AI devices, automotive radars, and optical modules, targeting high-end and emerging technology markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major production bases and subsidiaries in China (Shenzhen, Huai'an, Qinhuangdao), Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, India, Thailand, and Japan. Its sales are predominantly to customers registered in the United States (over 80% of revenue), Greater China, other Asian countries, and Europe. The company is expanding production capacity in Thailand and Taiwan to support global market demand.
categories.supply_chain_position: Avary Holding operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of PCBs. It sources raw materials such as copper foil and electronic components upstream and delivers finished PCB products downstream to OEMs and brand customers. The company also engages in R&D and design, providing integrated solutions along the value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-end PCB technologies aligned with AI, 5G, automotive electronics, and digital transformation. It emphasizes R&D in AI cloud, edge, and terminal products, high-frequency/high-speed PCBs, and advanced materials. The company invests heavily in innovation, patent development, and collaborates with leading universities and industry partners to maintain technological leadership. It also prioritizes green manufacturing and carbon neutrality initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized PCB products to global electronic brands and ODMs. The company operates on a build-to-order production model, ensuring tailored solutions for customers. Additional income streams include government subsidies, investment income, and rental income from leasing properties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Avary Holding is a global leader in the PCB industry, ranked first in China and among the top worldwide by revenue for eight consecutive years. It competes with other major PCB manufacturers globally, leveraging its comprehensive product portfolio, technological innovation, and scale. The company benefits from industry consolidation trends favoring large, technologically advanced players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenues of approximately RMB 35.14 billion, a 9.59% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.62 billion, up 10.14%. Total assets reached RMB 44.54 billion, and net assets RMB 32.11 billion, reflecting steady growth and strong financial health. The company maintains robust cash flow and a healthy debt ratio of 27.44%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Avary Holding offers a one-stop, full-spectrum PCB product and service platform with a diverse and high-quality product range tailored to meet the evolving needs of AI, 5G, automotive, and consumer electronics markets. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, rapid order response, high-volume supply capacity, and stringent quality assurance. The company’s commitment to green manufacturing and digital transformation further differentiates it by aligning with global sustainability trends and customer demands.
